الشبكة في أغسطس
headline:
تأجيل The Duskbloods
إلى 2027
label: تأجيل
note: Primary: FromSoftware, The Duskbloods official site news 2026.10.29 '発売時期変更のお知らせ' (fromsoftware.jp/duskbloods/article/261029_1.html): release moved from 2026 to 2027 to take time for final adjustment of game rules and balance, to realise the concept praised in the August 2026 network test (not only direct combat but varied play and strategies); apology. Footage: official Closed Network Test trailer (Nintendo Direct June 2026) from IGN's video page, 3840x2160 (the 2560 copy is 2.8 Mbps, flagged); Nintendo's store copy is 720p. Japanese subtitles burnt in from 26 to 38 s avoided; the vampire drinking shot (18 s) avoided. Sound: the trailer from 2.0 s, music only until speech at 17.2 s.
